pin-empty.description: No digits entered: six empty boxes (border-input) and the Continue button disabled (fewer than 4 digits).

pin-full.description: Maximum of six digits entered; the keypad ignores further taps.

pin-error.description: A failed assignment returns to the PIN step with a cleared PIN and the destructive "Assignment Failed" alert above it.

table-empty.description: Second step: free-text table field with its placeholder; Assign Table is disabled until a value is typed.

table-filled.description: A table typed: the field is focused (border-primary, ring) with a character count and Assign Table enabled.

assigning.description: assign_device_table in flight: spinner and "Assigning…", the field, Assign and Back disabled (opacity-50).
